longDescription:
Vivaldi is a Chromium-based browser built around extensive customization and power-user features. It includes tab stacking and tiling, workspaces, web panels, keyboard and mouse shortcuts, mail and calendar integration, notes, and flexible interface themes.

The stable release channel is installed from Vivaldi Technologies' official Debian repository.
script:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail

export LC_ALL=C
export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive

fail() {
    printf '%s: %s\n' 'vivaldi-stable' "$*" >&2
    exit 1
}

ARCH="$(dpkg --print-architecture)"
[ "$ARCH" = amd64 ] || fail "unsupported architecture: $ARCH"

if ! command -v curl >/dev/null 2>&1 || [ ! -s /etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt ]; then
    apt-get update
    apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends ca-certificates curl
fi

install -d -m 0755 /usr/share/keyrings /etc/apt/sources.list.d
curl -fL --retry 3 --connect-timeout 15 -o '/usr/share/keyrings/vivaldi-browser.asc' 'https://repo.vivaldi.com/archive/linux_signing_key.pub'
chmod 0644 '/usr/share/keyrings/vivaldi-browser.asc'

cat >'/etc/apt/sources.list.d/vivaldi.sources' <<'EOF'
Types: deb
URIs: https://repo.vivaldi.com/archive/deb/
Suites: stable
Components: main
Architectures: amd64
Signed-By: /usr/share/keyrings/vivaldi-browser.asc
EOF
chmod 0644 '/etc/apt/sources.list.d/vivaldi.sources'

apt-get update
apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends 'vivaldi-stable'
dpkg-query -W -f='${Status}\n' 'vivaldi-stable' | grep -Fqx 'install ok installed' || fail 'package installation was not recorded by dpkg'

rm -f -- '/etc/apt/sources.list.d/vivaldi.list'
apt-get clean
